# `tfctl run`

The `tfctl run` command group provides subcommands for managing Terraform runs.

## Usage

```shell-session
$ tfctl run <subcommand> [options]
```

## Description

The `tfctl run` command group provides subcommands for managing Terraform runs. Use these commands to start new runs and check the status of existing runs.

## Subcommands

- [`start`](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli/run/start) - Start a new Terraform run
- [`status`](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli/run/status) - Check the status of a run
